summary: Trade ran cleanly from 0 to a +59pt peak over ~7min with strong momentum across TFs. At t=9m a sharp reversal hit (all three fire signals - KMDR, HA, PROPP - flipped against) that erased most of the gain in one bar; I held one more frame to check for a dip vs. real reversal. At t=10m price broke fully through entry into negative territory (-13), a full round-trip of the entire gain with ER10 collapsing to 0.18, confirming a genuine reversal rather than noise, so I bailed. Next time: watch for the pattern of ALL fire signals flipping against simultaneously after an extended run - that combined with an efficiency-ratio collapse is a faster tell than waiting for the full round-trip through entry.
